name: toolchain-xtensa
description: ESP8266 slot of the espressif8266 platform (toolchain-xtensa): GCC 14.2 target libraries of the ESP8266 (lx106, call0): libgcc, newlib and newlib-nano 4.3, libstdc++, with their headers. Built by GitHub Actions from Espressif's sources of the esp-14.2.0_20260121 release (build-lx106.sh); the compiler is Espressif's toolchain-xtensa-esp-elf 14.2 with xtensa_esp8266.so
